name: 34237 · Sarasota, FL
findings: ZIP 34237 (Sarasota) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34237 (Sarasota) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34237 (Sarasota) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
